title: Pack manifest (pack.yaml)
$comment: Generated by scripts/generate_pack_manifests.py and validated on load by scripts/validate_pack_yaml.py. Schema introduced in road-to-6.0.0-D Phase 0 Step 2. `dependencies` is the artefact-level include graph (skills/rules the pack's commands reference); `requires` is the pack-level hard-dependency graph (must be acyclic — enforced by scripts/lint_pack_dependencies.py).

id.description: Pack id — globally unique, lowercase slug.

slug_prefix.description: Opt-in command-slug prefix (ADR-044 amendment A3). When set, every command in this pack projects as `<slug_prefix>-<subpath>` (e.g. the `git` pack with `slug_prefix: git` → `git/commit` → `git-commit`). Default = absent = no prefix; the pack-stripped subpath is the bare slug. The only sanctioned way to obtain a pack-prefixed slug — no per-command override.

requires.description: Hard pack-level dependencies (transitive, acyclic). Each id must resolve to a real pack.

suggests.description: Soft companion packs (one-hop, advisory, never auto-installed).

dependencies.description: Artefact-level include graph derived from command/rule frontmatter.
